shared_elements: single anthropomorphic figure as the dominant subject
human figure with visible torso and limbs carved/engraved in relief
justification: Both surfaces are dominated by a single anthropomorphic figure, but that is about as generic a correspondence as exists; A shows a winged, elaborately costumed figure with headdress, hatched wing and bird-head details, kneeling and holding objects inside a scalloped circular frame, while B shows a plain, unadorned, apparently nude standing figure in high volumetric relief against a flat block with linear sign-work beside it. The manner of depiction also diverges sharply: A is flat, linear and densely patterned with schematic infill, B is rounded and largely undetailed, with no wings, costume, attributes or enclosing border.
